name: Sunken Temple
note: "with one or more Mighty units" is part of the trigger condition (CR 383.2.a.1) but is re-checked at resolution, after the [1] was paid at finalization. Setup: P1 conquers Sunken Temple with a 5M unit, says yes and pays [1]; P2 responds with Stupefy on that unit (5->4) or kills it. Expected: P1 draws 1. Actual: onTrigger returns at the has_mighty check, so the [1] is paid and nothing is drawn (0532_sunken_temple.cpp:29-36, which runs before the costAlreadyPaid gate).

name: Charm
note: Always moves the unit to base. A move may go to any other valid location (CR 355.4.a). Setup: an enemy unit in its base, or at BF0. Play Charm on it. Expected: it can be moved to a battlefield (or BF0->BF1). Actual: moveToBase, which does nothing for a unit already at base (0043_charm.cpp:33). No destination choice (moveDests/moveTo helpers are not used).

name: Defy
note: Only peeks at the top of the chain. hasLegalTargets ignores the cost limit. (1) Chain: P1 spell A (cost 2) under P1's own reaction B (cost 5+). P2 can't Defy A: at resolution only B is checked, B fails the cost check, and Defy does nothing (0045_defy.cpp:33-50). (2) With only a cost-6 spell on the chain, Defy is still playable (0045:22-29) and fizzles; it should have no legal target. Note: engine-wide peek-and-pop convention.

name: Scuttle Crab
note: The Deathknell clause "You can look at their facedown cards this turn" is not implemented (0615_scuttle_crab.cpp:26-39). It only reveals the hand and gives XP. Opponent's hidden cards at battlefields are not revealed to the controller. Information only.

name: Hidden Blade
note: Played from facedown, the target chosen in the play intent (restricted to the hidden BF, game_engine.cpp:3517-3545) is ignored. executePlayFromHidden calls addSpell(intent.targets) without setting resume_data[5] (game_engine.cpp:2925), so pickTarget (0213:30-31) asks again at resolution from every unit at any battlefield. Setup: hide at BF0, play from facedown targeting enemy X at BF0. Expected: only units at BF0 are legal, and X is locked in. Actual: a new choice among units at all BFs at resolution.

name: Rockfall Path
note: engine flag; play generators skip it

name: Back Off
note: Same facedown-target bug as Hidden Blade. Played from facedown, intent.targets is ignored and pickTarget (0604_back_off.cpp:27-28) asks again at resolution from every unit anywhere (game_engine.cpp:2925 does not set resume_data[5]). Expected (CR 811.1.d.2): the stun target must be at the hidden BF, chosen at play.

name: Singularity
note: count=2 non-pair spell: the generator only emits (friendly, enemy) pairs (game_engine.cpp:3744-3762). Setup: P2 has two units, P1 has none. Expected: Singularity can deal 6 to each of them. Actual: no play intent at all. With units on both sides, it can't hit two enemies or just one unit. "Up to two" and the 0/1-target options are missing (0105_singularity.cpp:19).

name: First Mate
note: The trigger never readies anything. TriggerManager::fireTrigger adds the ability with empty targets (trigger_manager.cpp:248, addAbility without targets), and onTrigger only acts on targets[0] (0132_first_mate.cpp:18-19). Setup: an exhausted friendly unit, then play First Mate. Expected: the unit becomes ready. Actual: no change. The "another" (exclude self) restriction is also missing.

name: Ride the Wind
note: Always moves to base (0173_ride_the_wind.cpp:32). Setup: an exhausted friendly unit in base. Play Ride the Wind. Expected: move it to a battlefield and ready it (its main use). Actual: a base->base "move" plus ready. A unit at BF0 also can't go to BF1. There is no destination choice.

name: Targon's Peak
note: "Ready up to 2 runes": the code auto-readies the first 2 exhausted runes in object-map order (0284_targon_s_peak.cpp:38-46). The player can't choose which runes (domain matters for Power on the opponent's turn) or fewer. Setup: exhausted Fury, Fury and Calm runes, player wants Calm ready. Actual: map order decides.

name: Not So Fast
note: Only checks the chain top, in both hasLegalTargets and resolve (0368_not_so_fast.cpp:23-24). Setup: an enemy spell targeting my unit, with another item (e.g. an enemy trigger or my own reaction) on top of it. Expected: Not So Fast can counter the spell. Actual: not playable, or at resolution it checks the wrong item. Note: engine-wide peek-and-pop convention.

name: Overzealous Fan
note: "An attacking unit" should be the controller's choice. The code uses only the first attacker found at defend time (trigger_manager.cpp:471-479, then 0449_overzealous_fan.cpp:27-38). Setup: two enemy units attack the Fan's BF. Expected: the Fan's controller picks which one goes to base. Actual: whichever comes first in object-map order.

name: Sprite Burst
note: Tokens are always created in base (0631_sprite_burst.cpp:20). The text gives no location, so they may be played to any location they can be played to, i.e. a battlefield you control (CR 440.2.b.1). Setup: P1 controls BF0 and casts Sprite Burst. Expected: may put the two ready 3M Sprites at BF0. Actual: base only. Moving them later costs an exhaust.

name: Tideturner
note: Never swaps. The trigger chain item gets empty targets (trigger_manager.cpp:248), and onTrigger returns at `if (targets.empty()) return;` (0199_tideturner.cpp:35) before the "you may" prompt. Setup: friendly unit at BF0, play Tideturner to base. Expected: option to swap. Actual: nothing. The target list also lacks the "at another location" filter (self and same-location units are included, 0199:24-33).

name: Cull the Weak
note: The opponent doesn't choose which of their units dies: the code kills the first unit in object-map order (0209_cull_the_weak.cpp:41-47). Setup: P2 has a 1M token and a 6M champion. Expected: P2 chooses (the token). Actual: the lowest object id dies.

name: Honest Broker
note: The Gold token enters READY: createGoldToken passes enter_ready=false, but createToken only exhausts units (effect_executor.cpp:1251). Setup: Honest Broker dies. Expected: an exhausted Gold. Actual: a ready Gold, usable at once (0476_honest_broker.cpp:20; createGoldExhausted would be correct).

name: Sprite Fountain
note: The Deathknell never fires in real play. Gear death in EffectExecutor::killObject emits only LeftBoardEvent (effect_executor.cpp:287-289), which has no subscriber. WhenIDie fires only from onUnitDied (trigger_manager.cpp:640). Setup: play Sprite Fountain, then at the next Beginning Phase Temporary kills it. Expected: a second ready 3M Temporary Sprite. Actual: none. The tests call fireTriggerAs directly, so they don't catch this.

name: Vex, Apathetic
note: "They can't move it this turn" is not implemented (TODO at 0712_vex_apathetic.cpp:20-21; only stunUnitBy at :31; cant_move_on_turn is not set). Setup: Vex at a BF, opponent plays a unit with Accelerate (ready). Expected: stunned and unable to move this turn. Actual: it can still standard-move. Also "while I'm at a battlefield" is a trigger condition (CR 383.2.a.1) but is checked at resolution (:26), so if Vex dies or moves to base in response, no stun.

name: Star Spring
note: The player can't choose which other unit to move: the code moves the first unit in `movable` (object-map order) (0771_star_spring.cpp:65-70). Setup: P1 has units A and B at Star Spring and plays C there. Expected: P1 picks A or B (or neither). Actual: yes/no only, and the lowest id is moved.

name: Falling Star
note: Target lists ignore "can't be chosen by enemy spells" (all_units at 0029_falling_star.cpp:26-31 doesn't check untargetable_by_enemy). Setup: P2 controls Ruin Runner. Expected: not choosable. Actual: offered, and Falling Star can deal 3 to it twice.

name: Salvage
note: "You may kill up to one gear" is forced when any gear exists. With legal gear targets, the generator emits only per-gear intents, and the no-target play is emitted only when the list is empty (game_engine.cpp:3737-3772; 0224_salvage.cpp:27). Setup: only P1's own gear is on board. Expected: can cast Salvage just to draw. Actual: must kill own gear to cast it.

name: Vilemaw's Lair
note: Only the standard-move generator honors blocks_move_to_base (game_engine.cpp:2997). EffectExecutor::moveToBase does not check it (effect_executor.cpp:739-761). Setup: a unit at Vilemaw's Lair, cast Ride the Wind / Charm / Overzealous Fan on it. Expected: the move is negated (CR 359.3.e.6 example uses exactly Ride the Wind + Vilemaw's Lair). Actual: the unit moves to base.

name: Lonely Poro
note: "Alone" is checked when the Deathknell resolves, not at death (CR 429.1.a.1.b: note the unit's info at death). Setup: Lonely Poro and another friendly unit at BF1, both killed by the same AoE (e.g. Unchecked Power). Expected: no draw (another friendly unit was there when it died). Actual: the other unit is already in trash at resolution, so it draws 1. Converse: a friendly unit moved/played to that BF before the trigger resolves blocks the draw. src/cards/units/0359_lonely_poro.cpp:30-38

name: Deadly Flourish
note: (1) Def sets Keyword::Reaction (line 81); the card has no [Reaction] (that text belongs to the Gold token's reminder). Setup: opponent's turn, opponent's spell on chain. Expected: Deadly Flourish can't be played. Actual: playable as a Reaction. (2) Target requirement lacks must_be_enemy (line 19). Setup: only a friendly unit on board. Expected: no legal target / can't hit own unit. Actual: can deal 3 to a friendly unit (and get Gold when it dies). src/cards/spells/0635_deadly_flourish.cpp:19,81

name: Abandon
note: Counters only the chain item directly below it (items.back()), not a chosen spell. Setup: opponent plays spell S, then a triggered/activated ability A goes on the chain above it (or you respond to your own spell first); play Abandon targeting S. Expected: S countered and returned to hand. Actual: top item is not S (an ability, or the wrong spell), so nothing (or the wrong spell) is countered; hasLegalTargets still allows playing it. src/cards/spells/0693_abandon.cpp:36-38 (same counter-top convention as counterChainTop)

name: Pit Rookie
note: No choice of unit: buffs the first other friendly unit in map order, and buffUnit does not cap at one buff (CR 702.3). Setup: two other friendly units, the first-iterated one already buffed. Expected: player chooses, e.g. the unbuffed unit gets +1 buff (or, if an already-buffed unit is chosen, nothing). Actual: the already-buffed unit is picked and goes to buff_count 2 (+1 Might more). src/cards/units/0136_pit_rookie.cpp:21-26

name: Fiora, Victorious
note: (1) Def prints Deflect, Ganking and Shield as base keywords (lines 49-53), so Fiora always has them. Setup: Fiora at 4 Might, opponent targets her. Expected: no Deflect tax, no Ganking, no Shield. Actual: has all three. (2) applyPassiveAura loops over every friendly object with 5+ Might, not only Fiora (lines 18-22). Setup: Fiora plus another friendly 5-Might unit. Expected: other unit gains nothing. Actual: it gains Deflect, Ganking, Shield. src/cards/units/0232_fiora_victorious.cpp:18-22,49-53

name: Monastery of Hirana
note: Player does not choose which unit spends the buff (CR 702.2.b): code removes the buff from the first buffed friendly unit found. Setup: conquer here with two buffed friendly units A and B, player wants to keep A's buff. Expected: player picks B. Actual: whichever is found first in state.objects loses it. src/cards/battlefields/0277_monastery_of_hirana.cpp:25-34,41-45

name: Sigil of the Storm
note: Player does not choose the rune (CR 355.10.f: "You choose from among your runes as the ability resolves"): code recycles the first rune found. Setup: conquer here with one ready and one exhausted rune. Expected: player may recycle the exhausted rune. Actual: the first rune in state.objects is recycled, possibly the ready one. src/cards/battlefields/0282_sigil_of_the_storm.cpp:22-30

name: Guardian Angel
note: Recall is done with moveToBase, which emits UnitMovedEvent, so "When I move" triggers fire; text says the recall "isn't a move". Setup: Stellacorn Herder (When I move, draw 1) equipped with Guardian Angel at a battlefield, dealt lethal damage. Expected: Angel dies, Herder healed/exhausted/recalled, no draw. Actual: Herder's WhenIMove fires, draw 1 (also WhenAFriendlyUnitMoves-style watchers). src/cards/gear/0374_guardian_angel.cpp:32 (src/engine/effect_executor.cpp:760)

name: Irelia, Fervent
note: Uses TriggerType::WhenYouChooseAFriendlyUnit, which the trigger manager fires on every OTHER friendly object when a friendly unit is chosen (trigger_manager.cpp:1109 skips id == e.object), and onTrigger ignores the subject. Setup: Irelia on board; you play a spell targeting another friendly unit, then one targeting Irelia. Expected: no bonus for the first, +1 [M] for the second. Actual: +1 [M] for the first, nothing for the second. src/cards/units/0380_irelia_fervent.cpp:19-25

name: Fizz, Trickster
note: Player does not choose the spell: find_spell always takes the most recently trashed spell with Energy cost <= 3, and if that one can't be played (canPlayPayingCost false, e.g. its Power can't be paid or it has no legal target) nothing is played even when another eligible spell could be. Setup: trash holds spell A (cost 2, wanted) then spell B (cost 1, trashed later). Expected: player may choose A. Actual: B is played. src/cards/units/0461_fizz_trickster.cpp:25-50

name: Irresistible Faefolk
note: Player does not choose the enemy unit: after "yes", code moves the first enemy unit found in state.objects that isn't already here. Setup: Faefolk moves to BF1; enemy units A (wanted) and B elsewhere. Expected: player picks A. Actual: whichever is iterated first is moved. src/cards/units/0674_irresistible_faefolk.cpp:28-52

name: Existential Dread
note: Target list is any enemy unit at a battlefield, not an attacking one (must_be_attacker filter missing; the Attacker check only happens at resolution). Setup: your own turn, enemy units only defending/idle at a battlefield, no attacker anywhere. Expected: no legal target, can't be played. Actual: playable, resolves doing nothing (still counts as playing a spell, e.g. triggers Ravenbloom Student); at resolution the picker also offers non-attackers. src/cards/spells/0696_existential_dread.cpp:18-31

name: Shadow's Call
note: (1) [Temporary] is granted with giveTemporaryKeyword (line 39), i.e. as a "this turn" keyword; the expiration step (game_engine.cpp:1421 expireTemporaryKeywords) clears it at end of turn, so the unit is never killed. Setup: cast on your unit X on your turn, pass to your next Beginning Phase. Expected: X is killed before scoring. Actual: X has lost [Temporary] and survives (free draw 2). (2) Target list lacks "without [Temporary]" (lines 18-21): a unit that already has [Temporary] can be chosen, making the drawback nothing. src/cards/spells/0727_shadow_s_call.cpp:18-21,39

name: Vi, Peacekeeper
note: The stun never happens: triggered abilities are put on the chain with no targets (TriggerManager::fireTrigger -> addAbility with empty targets; chooseTargetsAtFinalize only runs a finalize pass for kFinalizeTrigger cards), and onTrigger returns on empty targets. Setup: Vi attacks a battlefield holding an enemy unit. Expected: that enemy unit is stunned. Actual: nothing. Also its target list is enemy units at any battlefield, not "here". src/cards/units/0738_vi_peacekeeper.cpp:24-44

name: Amateur Recital
note: Same empty-targets problem: WhenYouHoldHere fires via fireBattlefieldTriggers -> addAbility with no targets, and onTrigger only acts when targets is non-empty, so the "you may move a unit to its base" never happens (no choice is offered). Setup: hold Amateur Recital with an enemy unit at another battlefield. Expected: you may send it to its base. Actual: nothing happens. src/cards/battlefields/0763_amateur_recital.cpp:17-24

name: Darius, Trifarian
note: Fires on every play and checks cards_played_this_turn == 2 when the trigger RESOLVES, not whether the triggering card was the second. Setup: play spell A (1st card), then in response play Reaction spell B (2nd card). B resolves -> Darius +2 [M] and ready; A resolves -> count is still 2 -> Darius +2 [M] and ready again. Expected: one trigger (+2 total). Actual: +4 and readied twice. Converse: a 3rd card played before the trigger resolves cancels it. Also Darius being the 2nd card himself never triggers (trigger_manager.cpp:348 skips the played object) - confirm intended. src/cards/units/0027_darius_trifarian.cpp:17-28

name: Zhonya's Hourglass
note: Recall is done with moveToBase, which emits UnitMovedEvent, so "When I move" triggers fire though the text says the recall "isn't a move". Setup: friendly Stellacorn Herder at a battlefield with Zhonya's Hourglass on board; Herder takes lethal damage. Expected: Zhonya dies, Herder healed/exhausted/recalled, no draw. Actual: Herder's WhenIMove fires, draw 1. src/cards/gear/0077_zhonya_s_hourglass.cpp:33 (src/engine/effect_executor.cpp:760)

name: Sneaky Deckhand
note: engine-handled open-BF play

name: Imperial Decree
note: Delayed 'when any unit takes damage this turn, kill it' is not modeled: on resolve it kills units that already have damage marked and nothing afterwards. Test: no damaged units; play Imperial Decree, then deal 1 to a 5-Might enemy unit the same turn. Expected: unit killed. Actual: survives; also a unit damaged earlier this turn but not via a new damage event is killed immediately (src/cards/spells/0221_imperial_decree.cpp:17-26).

name: Flash
note: 'Up to 2' not honored: pickTargetPair has no decline, so with 2+ friendly units at battlefields the player must move exactly two (and can never move zero). Test: 2 friendly units at battlefields, play Flash wanting to move only one. Expected: may move 1 (or 0). Actual: forced to pick 2 (src/cards/spells/0309_flash.cpp:43; comment at :33 admits the gap).

name: Long Sword
note: Quick-Draw only works in Closed State: (a) a main-phase play goes through the plain gear path (no target), so it enters base unattached although 'When you play it, attach it to a unit you control' always applies (game_engine.cpp:3146-3158, attach only if item.targets non-empty at :2549); (b) no Quick-Draw/Reaction gear path in generateShowdownActions, so it cannot be played during a showdown open state. Test: main phase with a friendly unit, play Long Sword -> expected attached to a unit; actual unattached in base.

name: Rengar, Pouncing
note: [Reaction] on a unit is only honored for plays to a battlefield where you are attacking (playableAsReactionToAttack, game_engine.cpp:3343/3483); closed-state/showdown generators have no generic Reaction-unit play. Test: opponent's turn, opponent plays a spell (closed state), Rengar in hand and affordable. Expected: may play Rengar to base (or a battlefield you control) as a Reaction. Actual: not offered.

name: Bellows Breath
note: Repeat can be paid any number of times (engine loop up to 32 tranches, game_engine.cpp:2183-2214) but CR 820.1.c.3 says each Repeat cost is paid only once. Test: ample runes, play Bellows Breath accepting Repeat twice. Expected: second Repeat not offered; 1 dmg x2 max. Actual: a 2nd/3rd tranche is offered and paid, dealing 3+ to each target. (Also the repeat reuses the play-time targets, no new choice per CR 820.2.)

name: Hard Bargain
note: (1) Always acts on the top chain item instead of the chosen spell: chain [enemy spell X, enemy ability Y], play Hard Bargain to counter X -> expected X countered unless paid [2]; actual no-op because top is an ability (src/cards/spells/0457_hard_bargain.cpp:34-38). (2) Repeat can be paid more than once (engine loop game_engine.cpp:2183, CR 820.1.c.3).

name: Switcheroo
note: Played from facedown, targets are not restricted to the battlefield it was hidden at (CR 811.1.d.2): onResolve ignores the play-time targets and pickTargetPair offers units at every battlefield. Test: Switcheroo hidden at BF1 with a unit there, two units at BF2; play from facedown. Expected: only BF1 units choosable. Actual: can swap the two BF2 units (src/cards/spells/0466_switcheroo.cpp:25-43).

name: Last Rites
note: (1) The granted 'When I conquer or hold, you may play a unit from your trash (You still pay its costs)' plays the unit for free via playIgnoringCost (src/cards/gear/0471_last_rites.cpp:85). Test: equipped unit conquers, trash has a 5-cost unit, 0 runes ready -> expected: cannot play it (must pay); actual: played free. (2) The equip cost's 'Recycle 2 cards from your trash' auto-picks the last 2 trash cards instead of letting the player choose (:44-51, also :29).

name: Deathgrip
note: If the recipient becomes illegal before resolution, the kill is skipped too: code requires both targets to exist (src/cards/spells/0484_deathgrip.cpp:23-24), but per CR 359.3.e.8 the 'Kill a friendly unit' instruction still executes on its valid target. Test: Deathgrip targeting A (kill) and B (recipient); opponent kills/bounces B in response. Expected: A killed, draw 1. Actual: A survives, draw 1.

name: Xin Zhao, Vigilant
note: 'Other units' is computed by skipping every unit with Xin Zhao's card def id (src/cards/units/0496_xin_zhao_vigilant.cpp:22), so another copy of Xin Zhao, Vigilant in base is not counted. Test: base has Xin Zhao, Vigilant #1 + one other unit; play Xin #2. Expected: enters ready (2 other units). Actual: enters exhausted.

name: Forge of the Fluft
note: Only unattached Equipment is offered (src/cards/battlefields/0522_forge_of_the_fluft.cpp:37 requires !attached_to), but 'Attach an Equipment you control to a unit you control' also lets you move an already-attached Equipment to another unit. Test: control Forge, Equipment attached to unit A, unit B also friendly; activate legend ability. Expected: may move the Equipment to B. Actual: ability does nothing (no equipment offered).

name: Grim Apothecary
note: The unit to return is not chosen by the player: find_friendly_at_bf returns the first friendly unit in map order (src/cards/units/0583_grim_apothecary.cpp:21-27,39), and it also excludes Grim Apothecary itself, which is a legal 'friendly unit at a battlefield' when Ambushed there. Test: friendly units A and B at battlefields, play Apothecary, accept. Expected: player picks A or B (or Apothecary). Actual: whichever comes first in the object map is bounced.

name: Nami, Headstrong
note: Hold rider readies+buffs ANY exhausted friendly unit the agent picks, not the unit just played (src/cards/units/0614_nami_headstrong.cpp:74-88); and if the played unit enters ready the arm is not consumed, so it carries to a later unit. Test: Nami holds; move unit X (exhausts); play unit Y. Expected: Y readied and buffed. Actual: may ready and buff X instead.

name: Repulse
note: Only the top chain item can be countered (answerable() reads chain.items.back(), src/cards/spells/0668_repulse.cpp:48-53). Test: chain [enemy spell X choosing only friendly unit U at a battlefield, any other item on top]; play Repulse choosing U. Expected: X countered. Actual: not playable / no effect because the top item does not choose U.

name: Master Yi, Tempered
note: Deflect and Ganking are always on, not only at Level 6: the def sets keywords Deflect+Ganking and deflect_value=1 (src/cards/units/0675_master_yi_tempered.cpp:61-63), copied to the object at creation (game_engine.cpp:5688-5691); effect_executor.cpp:362 applies Deflect whenever deflect_value>0. Test: controller has 0 XP, Yi at BF1, BF2 exists. Expected: Yi cannot move BF1->BF2 and opponents choose him without paying [A]. Actual: he can move and the [A] tax is charged.

name: Elder Dragon
note: 'Choose up to one enemy unit at each location' has no player choice: it always damages the first enemy unit at every location (src/cards/units/0680_elder_dragon.cpp:33-41). Test: two enemy units at one battlefield (a 1-Might and an 8-Might). Expected: controller picks which one (or none). Actual: always the first in unitsAt order, no option to skip.

name: Baron Nashor
note: +2 aura via engine text parser

name: Ashe, Focused
note: 'When they hold, return it to their hand' is not implemented; the card stays banished forever (src/cards/units/0731_ashe_focused.cpp:47-50). Test: Ashe banishes card X from opponent's hand; opponent later holds a battlefield. Expected: X returns to opponent's hand. Actual: X remains in banishment.

name: Sacrifice
note: The additional cost 'kill a friendly Mighty unit' is paid at resolution, not as the spell is played (src/cards/spells/0735_sacrifice.cpp:37-42; CR example at core-rules line 328). Test: play Sacrifice choosing a 5-Might friendly unit; opponent counters Sacrifice. Expected: unit already dead (cost paid). Actual: unit survives. Also if the unit drops below 5 Might in response, nothing happens (no kill, no draw) instead of draw 2 + channel.

name: Tactical Retreat
note: The replacement recall strips the unit's gear (game_engine.cpp:6748 detachAllGear; effect_executor.cpp:184-190), but a recall is a location change on the board and attached cards move with the unit (CR 719.3.a, 460). Test: friendly unit with an Equipment at a battlefield, cast Tactical Retreat on it, then kill it. Expected: unit healed, exhausted, in base with the Equipment still attached. Actual: Equipment detached (left at the battlefield, later recalled unattached).

name: Draven, Showboat
note: engine aura (game_engine.cpp:5216)

name: Sona, Harmonious
note: 'Ready up to 4 friendly runes' gives no choice: it readies the first 4 exhausted runes in object-map order (src/cards/units/0073_sona_harmonious.cpp:24-31), so the player cannot pick which runes (domains) to ready. Test: Sona at a battlefield, 6 exhausted runes (3 Fury, 3 Calm) at end of turn. Expected: player picks up to 4, e.g. all 3 Calm. Actual: map-order first 4.

name: Confront
note: 'Units you play this turn enter ready' is not implemented; only Draw 1 happens (src/cards/spells/0129_confront.cpp:17-26). Test: play Confront, then play a unit. Expected: unit enters ready. Actual: enters exhausted.

name: Pack of Wonders
note: Facedown cards can't be returned: legal list requires obj.location, but hidden cards have location=nullopt/zone FacedownZone. Setup: own a card hidden at a battlefield; activate Pack; expected: may return the facedown card to hand; actual: not offered (0181_pack_of_wonders.cpp:47,51).

name: Call to Glory
note: Optional additional cost (spend a buff to ignore the cost) not modeled. Setup: control a buffed unit, 0 runes ready; expected: may play Call to Glory free by spending the buff; actual: can't play, always pays [3] (0207_call_to_glory.cpp:20-24, no optionalAdditionalCost/altPlayCost).

name: Spectral Matron
note: [A] read as available power instead of a power cost of at most 1. Setup: trash has a unit costing [2][A][A] (power 2) and you have 3 ready runes; expected: not eligible; actual: eligible (only energy cost checked, vs <=3 and <= ready runes). Also a [3]-energy 0-power unit is wrongly excluded when you have <3 ready runes (0226_spectral_matron.cpp:43-45).

name: Viktor, Leader
note: Non-Recruit filter missing. Setup: Viktor + a friendly Recruit token; Recruit dies; expected: no token; actual: another Recruit token is played (0246_viktor_leader.cpp:22-26; triggering_subject is available on the chain item).

name: Dark Child - Starter
note: runes picked automatically (no real choice)

name: Gem Jammer
